prompts.residential:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for TOUCHLINE, an original Brazilian football life RPG. Make a genuine transparent RGBA PNG sprite sheet, square 1024x1024, EXACT regular 4-column by 4-row grid, each cell 256x256, with ONE isolated asset fully contained in each cell. No grid lines, labels, text, letters, numbers, interface, watermark, checkerboard painted into image, ground scene, or contact shadows outside sprites. Consistent strictly 2:1 isometric view, top-left illumination, warm Brazilian small-town atmosphere, restrained navy/amber/earth/sage palette, crisp hand-placed pixel art with visible chunky pixel clusters equivalent to native 64x32 terrain tiles, 2-3 shade ramps, NO blur, NO smooth gradients, NO anti-aliased illustration, NO 3D render, NO photographic texture. Magnified nearest-neighbor look. Center each sprite in its cell; leave at least 20 transparent pixels clear on all sides and between sprites. Terrain diamonds must be flat seamless 2:1 rhombi with no extrusion or drop shadow, apex upward, centered on the same baseline. All other objects stand on the same isometric floor plane. Entire object visible. Assets must be originals, no real football logos or trademarks.
Theme: cozy modest rented apartment in fictional Santa Aurora. Read positions left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: four flat floor tile diamonds, honey oak wood plank variant A; honey oak wood plank variant B same palette and seamless edge color; warm terracotta ceramic tile; muted blue-green woven rug diamond.
Row 2: four modular wall panels, sage plaster LEFT-FACING wall segment; sage plaster RIGHT-FACING segment; LEFT-FACING sage wall with a small wood-framed daylight window; RIGHT-FACING sage wall with a framed dark teal closed wooden door. Walls are plain vertical parallelograms above a single tile edge.
Row 3: low single bed with cream pillow and desaturated teal blanket, wooden headboard; small wooden work desk with open dark laptop and papers; tall two-door walnut wardrobe; small amber cardboard memory box taped shut with a paper label containing NO legible writing.
Row 4: leafy potted indoor plant in terracotta pot; simple wood dining chair; compact cream refrigerator; modest blue-green upholstered two-seat sofa.
Keep the pixel aesthetic authentically retro, high craft, no painterly smoothing.

Theme: outdoor football training center in Brazilian countryside, muted green turf, sunlit earth, original navy/amber equipment.
Row 1: four flat floor tile diamonds, muted green closely cut grass A; matching grass B with sparse blades; warm dirt path; gray rough concrete walkway. Seamless, not individual raised platforms.
Row 2: four modular boundary pieces: LEFT-FACING low brick wall topped by a simple chainlink fence; RIGHT-FACING matching piece; LEFT-FACING chainlink fence with gate; RIGHT-FACING navy changing-room door in cream wall.
